scope.statement: This append-only snapshot records the merged state at the commit intended for the 2026-09-11 stage-4 small-notional launch probe (bot-strategy#849/#845). PASS applies only to the named offline gate and is not authorization for deployment, signing, funding, staking, or live operation.

verification_runs.result: Master CI (quality, locked AL2023 ARM64 release artifact, locked AL2023 ARM64 live-probe artifact) completed successfully at this commit
193 tests across default and live-probe feature configurations passed locally in a clean worktree (0 failed, 0 ignored)

The v4.7.21 annotated tag peels to 623dad52febd076b28244443ab2cfb4ce07ac08d, the exact revision Cargo.lock pins and hype-accumulator compiles against (git rev-parse v4.7.21 alone returns the tag object 74ac00bf..., not the commit)

required_gates.summary: Point-in-time fixture mechanics, arbitrary capital paths, one durable UTC decision per day, capital conservation, execution caps, and DRY_RUN signal attribution remain deterministic; this does not establish economic edge. Unchanged in substance since the previous snapshot; PR #47's new aggregation function and PR #48's fee-reserve cross-check are additional deterministic, offline-testable invariants layered on the same design.

The signer-free workflow now also persists authenticated order-submission evidence, fills, and terminal finality durably (PR #46), and aggregates terminal residual HYPE across past journals (PR #47), but it still cannot prove venue-enforced acceptance deadline behavior or signer capability, and the durable order-finality flow is still not connected to the capital ledger's exactly-once debit (bot-strategy#901 item 5, confirmed by code inspection: `pacing::settle_decision` is called only from the zero-value DRY_RUN cycle, never from the live-probe order-finality path). Offline simulation therefore cannot change this gate to PASS.

evidence.result: Automatic staking remains disabled pending venue-enforced acceptance deadlines, revised custody review, and explicit approval; unchanged since the previous snapshot

required_gates.summary: The pinned connector lineage contains deterministic HYPE spot vectors, authoritative account-movement normalization, and ambiguity-safe order reconciliation. dex-connector v4.7.21 additionally exposes the raw per-fill tx hash and raw orderStatus/spotClearinghouseState response bodies that hype-accumulator's PR #46 now independently re-derives evidence from, rather than trusting echoed fields.

Account-bound staking reads, deterministic cDeposit/tokenDelegate vectors, fail-closed validator policy, guarded submission primitives, and ambiguity reconciliation pass offline tests without proving signer capability. Unchanged in substance since the previous snapshot; automatic staking remains hard-disabled and out of scope for the 2026-09-11 probe entirely (staking deferred post-launch per bot-strategy#849).

Protected ledger replay detects tampering, rollback, and divergent restore candidates while preserving crash-safe recovery semantics, per the original offline PR. A separate, non-stage-1 production off-host restore drill (real AWS S3 boundaries, real ledger, real tamper-detection) has since been completed against the actual deployment host under bot-strategy#839 on 2026-09-07 and is recorded there, not here, because it is network/deployment evidence excluded from this offline scope by design.

Unknown fields and unsafe live configuration fail closed; DRY_RUN and manual halt remain the defaults and live execution remains unavailable. PR #48 adds a new live-readiness cross-check (fee_spread_reserve_bps >= max_purchase_fee_bps) that fails --install-preflight closed on an otherwise-unsubmittable combination that would previously only have surfaced as a live order rejection.

Offline tests cover durable decision status, skip reasons, stale inputs, reconciliation state, suppression, workflow age, and privacy-safe metrics; deployed alert routing remains separate. PR #49 pins and documents the S3 status-mirror's write-ordering invariant (put_timeout_cannot_outlive_a_cycle, mutation-checked) that a prior review flagged (bot-strategy#920, now closed) as an unstated dependency between a source constant and an external systemd timer.

The annotated dex-connector staking release (originally landed as v4.7.14, PR #71) remains merged and unchanged; hype-accumulator now pins the later v4.7.21 tag (a direct tag+master push per this project's documented dex-connector bump convention, not a PR — no staking-related change occurred between v4.7.14 and v4.7.21, confirmed by inspecting the intervening commits). pairtrade's production services were sunset 2026-09-06 and its dex-connector dependency is a local path, not a tag pin, so it no longer functions as a second active caller in the sense this gate originally described; hype-accumulator remains an active, correctly-pinned caller of the staking capability, which is what this gate actually tracks going forward.
